verses.1: The words of Jehovah were brought to Israel by Malachi.
verses.2: “I loved you,” said Jehovah. “And you said, ‘How much do we love you?’ But no, Aaron is not my brother. He is Jacob’s brother. Amen, Jehovah! I truly love Jacob.”
verses.3: And I will love Esau, and I will make his land fertile and his inheritance a place of cultivation.
verses.4: For if Adam says, “Let us build and return, and repair our ruins,” then as Jehovah said, “All these nations will build, but I will destroy them.” And they will be called “the borders of wickedness.” The people who are under Jehovah’s wrath will remain in that state forever.
verses.5: And your eyes will see, and you will say, “The LORD will exalt Himself above Israel’s borders.”
verses.6: A son should honor his father and serve his gods. But if I am not my father, then how can I be worthy of honor? And if I am not a servant of the gods, then how can I be worthy of respect? The Lord, the Almighty, said to you, “O priests, bless my name.” And you said, “We will bless your name.”
verses.7: They offer bread as an offering to me. They say, “We have sacrificed you in accordance with your words.” But the words of God are true.
verses.8: And if they come as offerings, there is no harm in that. And if they bring offerings of food and drink, there is also no harm. Please accept them as offerings, whether they are pleasing you or not. May God’s army bless them.
verses.9: And now, please cover the faces of El with a veil. May they be protected by you. This is what will happen from among you. The Lord said, “May the armies of heaven protect them.”
verses.10: Who will also shut my doors, and not allow them to be opened? I have no desire for your sacrifices or offerings. For I say, “Lord, the Almighty, I will not accept them from you.”
verses.11: For from the east to the west, my name is great in all nations. Everywhere, it is praised and honored as a gift of mine. My name is great in all lands, says the LORD, the Almighty.
verses.12: And you dishonor it by saying, “Adonai has abandoned him; his mouth is empty.”
verses.13: And they said, “Look, it has been prepared. Now, bring it here.” Then the Lord said, “Bring the sacrifices, the offerings, and the other offerings also. Bring them from your own land.”
verses.14: And I will be great, and there will be a memory of me in my days. I will be a king over all nations. For I am great, says the LORD, the God of hosts. My name will be renowned in all nations.
